# Layout

Utility functions for laying out content with campus's layout classes, such as l-2col.

```js
import { toGridRows } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/layout';
```

## Contents

- [toGridRows(items, columnCount)](#togridrowsitems-columncount)
- [GridRow](#gridrow)
- [GridColumn](#gridcolumn)

## toGridRows(items, columnCount)

Groups items into rows of 2, 3 or 4 columns, with the campus layout class for each row and column,
e.g. for rendering a list of cards in a grid.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Array` | The items to lay out, in order. |
| `columnCount` | `Number` | Columns per row: 2, 3 or 4. Other numbers are rounded and clamped to that range, and a non-number gives the default. Default: 2 |

**Returns:** `GridRow[]`

### Examples

```js
import { toGridRows } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/layout';

// in a Lit template
${toGridRows(this.cards, 3).map(row => html`
  <div class=${row.class}>
    ${row.columns.map(column => html`
      <div class=${column.class}>${column.item.title}</div>
    `)}
  </div>
`)}
```

## GridRow

Typedef: `Object`

A row from toGridRows.

### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | `String` | The row's layout class: l-2col, l-3col or l-4col. |
| `isFirstRow` | `Boolean` | Whether it's the first row. |
| `isLastRow` | `Boolean` | Whether it's the last row. |
| `columns` | `GridColumn[]` | The row's columns, in order. The last row may have fewer than the others. |

## GridColumn

Typedef: `Object`

A column in a GridRow.

### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | `String` | The column's position class: l-first, l-second, l-third or l-fourth. |
| `item` | `*` | The item from the array passed to toGridRows. |
